confidence_notes: FX comes from an RBA search result showing 0.6720 USD per AUD on 18 Nov 2026. Food and drink anchors are based on one search of aggregated cost-of-living sources, which disagreed with each other. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and midrange meal are moderately well supported. Cocktail and wine are set from the local relationship to beer, and restaurant beer and wine prices in tourist areas are higher than retail prices. Rajasthan has dry-day and licensing quirks. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against any listings. Udaipur is a high-demand lake-view tourist city, so accommodation prices vary widely by season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Jaipur and Pushkar-type Rajasthan tourist cities, with Udaipur somewhat pricier in the lakeside old town.
